sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?continentLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?studyCount) WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:wikidata:P30 ?continent .
  ?continent rdfs:label ?continentLabel .
} GROUP BY ?continentLabel ORDER BY DESC(?studyCount)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?taxonLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?approach .
  ?approach rdfs:label ?approachLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?approachLabel), "observational"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P39141 ?taxon .
  ?taxon rdfs:label ?taxonLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?scaleLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P115002 ?scale .
  ?scale rdfs:label ?scaleLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?scaleLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?dataSourceLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?studyCount) WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P112020 ?dataSource .
  ?dataSource rdfs:label ?dataSourceLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} GROUP BY ?paper ?paperLabel ?dataSourceLabel ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?countryLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:wikidata:P17 ?country .
  ?country rdfs:label ?countryLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?countryLabel ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?windRoseLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P149068 ?windRose .
  ?windRose rdfs:label ?windRoseLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?windRoseLabel)) = "yes")
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?diseaseLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P134011 ?disease .
  ?disease rdfs:label ?diseaseLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?diseaseLabel ?areaLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P134011 ?disease .
  ?disease rdfs:label ?diseaseLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?diseaseLabel)), "obes"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P135009 ?area .
  ?area rdfs:label ?areaLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?diseaseLabel ?dietLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P134011 ?disease .
  ?disease rdfs:label ?diseaseLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?diseaseLabel)), "type 2"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P191006 ?diet .
  ?diet rdfs:label ?dietLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel
